summary.text: Akbar Ali, a Democrat from Lawrenceville, represents Georgia House District 106.

paragraphs.text: According to WABE and Capitol Beat, Ali won a December 2, 2025 runoff against fellow Democrat Marqus A. Cole for the seat previously held by Rep. Shelly Hutchinson, who retired in September.
The report describes Ali as the state's youngest lawmaker, says he grew up attending a Gwinnett County mosque, and notes that his parents immigrated from Pakistan.
Ali serves on the House Creative Arts & Entertainment, Economic Development & Tourism, and Urban Affairs committees.

sources.title: Georgia's youngest lawmaker hopes to implement 'foundational change' this legislative session
